name: François Asselineau
declaration_note: Candidature confirmée le 7 juillet 2026 sur TV Finance (relayée par upr.fr) ; recherche de parrainages en cours (appel du 23 octobre 2026 sur upr.fr).
program_status_note: Pas de programme 2027 à ce jour : programme 2022 de l'UPR et pages du site, annoncé « prochainement ».
notes: upr.fr/notre-programme explicitly says « Notre programme présidentiel 2027 sera publié prochainement » — re-check before launch. No 2024 full program: UPR ran list 'Asselineau-Frexit' in européennes 2024 (profession de foi archived, ~5.7k chars); Asselineau's législatives 2024 profession de foi (11e circ. Français de l'étranger) was archived then removed — it is only a biography, no proposals. I archived the 2022 presidential+legislative program (upr.fr page, 68k chars, same content as /post-img/uploads/2022/10/20220215_Programme-presi-leg-2022.pdf) because it is the party's latest full program and is presented on the official site as the current edition until 2027's is out — note this differs from le-pen, where the 2022 materials were skipped because more recent 2024/2025 RN documents existed. 'Nos fondamentaux' is very short (422 chars, bullet list). Not archived: /le-retour-au-franc (2k chars, argumentative), /charte-fondatrice (founding charter, 26k chars, mostly analysis — could be added if the lead wants more coverage). asselineau.fr is NOT his (belongs to an unrelated Thierry Asselineau). Status caveat: still needs 500 parrainages (failed in 2022); a judicial case (sexual harassment/assault) was reported sent to trial in press, while upr.fr says the investigating judges issued a non-lieu now appealed by the prosecution.
